name: tripdeal
description: tripdeal can help you find hotels, compare room options, check prices and availability, provide hotel details, and guide you through the booking process. Whether you're planning a business trip, a family vacation, or a last-minute getaway, I'll help you find the best stay based on your destination, dates, budget, and preferences.

_published_faq.name: How do I add tripdeal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add tripdeal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude-mcp.tripdeal.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the tripdeal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: tripdeal provides these MCP tools: book_hotel_tool, cancel_booking_tool, destinations_tool, fetch_rooms_tool, filters_tool, get_booking_confirmation_tool, get_booking_details_tool, get_hotel_booking_tool, get_special_requests_options_tool, hotel_details_tool, payment_tool, and search_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to tripdeal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to tripdeal in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
tripdeal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
